messages:
Amit R: heads up — deprovision job failed for multiple service accounts this morning, looks like externalId collisions across IdPs :warning:
Amit R: sample log: `INFO scim-sync matchFound externalId=\"svc-billing\" matches=2 local_ids=[u789,u1023] action=skip`
Ken M: ugh. which mapping are we using to resolve? externalId should be unique but legacy IdP lets duplicates through
Amit R: our sync currently keys on `externalId` first, then `email` fallback. legacy IdP A and IdP B both emit the same externalId for different principals (they omitted idp prefix years ago)
Sara L: can we treat (idp,externalId) as the canonical key? that would avoid collisions without changing users' emails
Jess P: agree. plan: 1) dry-run reconcile to list impacted accounts, 2) backfill externalIds with `idp:` prefix for duplicates, 3) patch scim-sync to use tuple key and add idempotent migration
Amit R: created a quick dry-run command: `./tools/scim/reconcile --dry-run --reason "extid-dup-2025-03"` — output shows ~14 service accounts + 7 human users affected
Ken M: can you paste a couple of examples (anonymized)?
Amit R: `svc-billing (externalId=svc-billing, idp=old-idp-a) -> local u789` and `billing-svc (externalId=svc-billing, idp=old-idp-b) -> local u1023`
SCIM-Bot: Scheduled job `scim-backfill-extid-prefix` queued by @Ken M, eta 02:15 UTC
Sara L: for safety, run backfill with `--preview` and add an automatic rollback hook. also add monitoring to detect any new duplicates after deploy :eyes:
Jess P: I'll add a unit test for the tuple-key behavior and a migration script that is reversible. also we'll add an audit log entry whenever we rewrite an externalId: `audit.event=extid_rewrite actor=scim-backfill reason=duplicate`
Ken M: running preview now `./tools/scim/backfill --preview --limit 50` — results look good, no account collisions in preview. posting the mini-report to the thread :paperclip:
Amit R: after preview: thumbs up from infra, going to run full backfill in 30m during the low window. will update with results and run an immediate reconcile afterwards
Jess P: after full run we should update docs `docs/scim/mapping.md` to recommend `(idp,externalId)` and include a small FAQ for IdP admins. also add a synth check in onboarding to reject plain duplicated externalIds
Ken M: full backfill started. job id `sj-20250320-001`
SCIM-Bot: Job `sj-20250320-001` completed: 21 records updated, 0 failures — audit log entries created
Amit R: ran reconcile post-backfill: no orphaned service accounts. marking incident as mitigated. will schedule a follow-up to scan historical sync runs for similar patterns
Sara L: thanks everyone. follow-up action: create preventative alert in ops-monitoring when `scim.sync.duplicates > 0` for 1h :thumbsup:
Jess P: filed PRs: #1892 (tuple-key support) and #1893 (migration + tests). assigning reviewers: @Ken M, @Sara L
Ken M: LGTM, merge when CI green :shipit:
